title: Standing Female Deity
brief_description: Image of a Dwarapalika (female gatekeeper) on guard.
detailed_description: Highly embellished image of a Dwarapalika (female gatekeeper) on guard.The deity is holding a sword in her right hand and bowl in left hand. She is wearing elaborate neck ornament, Jatamukuta and garland.The conical topping of the slab is broken.She wears a dress of fine drapery.
